banner.title: kromgo
banner.tagline: Answers a fixed list of Prometheus queries as public JSON badges, and nothing else, for the GitHub profile.

explainer.title: Only /badges/ leaves the cluster, and only for fixed queries

steps.title: Allow-list
steps.text: kromgo-configmap lists each badge with one PromQL query. Clients choose a badge id, never a query.
steps.scene: a card holding a short numbered list

steps.title: Route
steps.text: The HTTPRoute on envoy-external forwards only the /badges/ path. There is no ExtAuth in front, on purpose.
steps.scene: a single lit path through a gateway arch

steps.title: Query
steps.text: A request runs its one query against prometheus-operated. Results are cached for 300 seconds.
steps.scene: a magnifying glass over a line chart

steps.title: Answer
steps.text: The reply is JSON with a label and a value. Every query aggregates away the labels, so no node, pod or IP leaves.
steps.scene: a JSON card with a checkmark

steps.title: Watch
steps.text: Gatus checks the cluster_node_count badge through the public route, so a broken route raises an alert.
steps.scene: a heartbeat trace running across a badge
